title: Comparing without a word for "more"
title_target: ជាង និង ជាងគេ — chièng neng chièng-ké
goal: Compare two things and name the best of all — with one word that goes after the adjective, not before it.
bekal: compare with A + adjective + ជាង + B
say "the most" with ជាងគេ
say "the same" with ដូចគ្នា and ស្មើ
compare amounts with ច្រើនជាង and តិចជាង

dialogs.title: កិច្ចសន្ទនា — At the foot of Angkor Wat
dialogs.intro: The trip to Siem Reap happens. Ani, Sokha, and Sreymom stand in front of Angkor Wat before dawn. Notice that in Khmer a comparison needs only **one** extra word, and it goes after.

lines.speaker: អានី:
lines.text: [ធំ|thum] [ជាង|chièng] [ខ្ញុំ|khnyom] [គិត|ket] [ណាស់|nah] [ចាស|chaah]!
lines.literal: big — more-than — I — think — very — yes(f)!

lines.speaker: សុខា:
lines.text: [អង្គរវត្ត|'ang-kaa-woat] [ជា|chiè] [ប្រាសាទ|pra-saat] [ធំ|thum] [ជាងគេ|chièng-ké] [ក្នុង|knong] [ពិភពលោក|pi-phup-lok] [បាទ|baat]។
lines.id: Angkor Wat is the largest temple in the world.
lines.literal: Angkor-Wat — is — temple — big — most — in — world — yes(m).

lines.text: [ព្រឹក|preuk] [នេះ|nih] [ត្រជាក់|tra-cheak] [ជាង|chièng] [ភ្នំពេញ|phnum-peñ] [ចាស|chaah]។
lines.id: This morning is colder than in Phnom Penh.

lines.text: [មែន|mèn] [ចាស|chaah]។ [ចុះ|choh] [ប្រាសាទ|pra-saat] [បាយ័ន|baa-yun] [វិញ|weñ]? [ធំ|thum] [ដូចគ្នា|douch-knie] [ទេ|té]?
lines.id: True. What about the Bayon? Is it the same size?
lines.literal: true — yes(f). and — temple — Bayon — then? big — same — (question)?

lines.speaker: សុខា:
lines.text: [អត់ទេ|'at-té]។ [បាយ័ន|baa-yun] [តូច|touch] [ជាង|chièng], [ប៉ុន្តែ|pon-tae] [ចំណាស់|cham-nah] [ជាង|chièng] [បាទ|baat]។
lines.id: No. The Bayon is smaller, but older.
lines.literal: no. Bayon — small — more-than, but — aged — more-than — yes(m).

lines.speaker: អានី:
lines.text: [ខ្ញុំ|khnyom] [ចូលចិត្ត|choul-chet] [មុខ|muk] [ថ្ម|thmòò] [នៅ|neuw] [បាយ័ន|baa-yun] [ជាងគេ|chièng-ké] [ចាស|chaah]។
lines.id: I like the stone faces at the Bayon best.
lines.literal: I — enter-heart — face — stone — at — Bayon — most — yes(f).

lines.text: [ខ្ញុំ|khnyom] [ក៏|kaa] [ដូចគ្នា|douch-knie] [ដែរ|dae] [ចាស|chaah]។

lines.text: [ថ្ងៃនេះ|thngay nih] [មនុស្ស|mò-nuh] [ច្រើន|chraeun] [ជាង|chièng] [ម្សិលមិញ|msel-meñ] [បាទ|baat]។

lines.literal: today — people — many — more-than — yesterday — yes(m).

lines.speaker: អានី:
lines.text: [បើ|baeu] [មក|mòòk] [ព្រឹក|preuk] [ជាង|chièng] [នេះ|nih] [វា|wie] [ស្ងាត់|sngat] [ជាង|chièng] [ទេ|té] [ចាស|chaah]?

lines.speaker: សុខា:
lines.text: [ស្ងាត់|sngat] [ជាង|chièng] [បន្តិច|ban-tech] [បាទ|baat]។ [ប៉ុន្តែ|pon-tae] [ព្រះអាទិត្យ|preah-'aa-tit] [មិន|min] [ទាន់|toan] [រះ|reah] [ទេ|té]។

lines.text: [នេះ|nih] [ជា|chiè] [ព្រឹក|preuk] [ស្អាត|s'aat] [ជាងគេ|chièng-ké] [ក្នុង|knong] [ជីវិត|chii-wit] [ខ្ញុំ|khnyom] [ចាស|chaah]។

lines.literal: this — is — morning — beautiful — most — in — life — I — yes(f).

grammars.title: ជាង — one word for the whole comparison
body: English uses an ending or two words: *bigger than*, *more beautiful than*. Khmer uses **one**: ជាង, which goes after the adjective and means both "more" and "than".

head: Khmer
Say it
Literally
Translation
rows: បាយ័នតូចជាងអង្គរវត្ត
the Bayon is smaller than Angkor Wat
ថោកជាងបន្តិច
ល្អជាងច្រើន

after: The pattern: **A + adjective + ជាង + B**. No linking word, no change to the adjective.
⚠️ A typical English-speaker mistake is to put something before the adjective, copying "more": ជាងធំ is wrong, ធំជាង is right. Remember the rule from Unit 14 — **all intensifiers go after** in Khmer.
For "much more" and "a little more", add ច្រើន or បន្តិច **after ជាង**: ធំជាងច្រើន, ធំជាងបន្តិច.

grammars.title: ជាងគេ — the most
body: To say "the most", just add គេ (*ké*, "the others, everyone") after ជាង. Literally "more than everyone".

head: Khmer
Say it
Translation
rows: ខ្ញុំចូលចិត្តនេះជាងគេ
ថ្ងៃក្តៅជាងគេក្នុងឆ្នាំ
the hottest day of the year
ប្រាសាទធំជាងគេក្នុងពិភពលោក
the largest temple in the world

after: To set the scope, use ក្នុង (in) + a place or time — just like English "in the world", "of the year". ⚠️ Note that **គេ never changes**, whether you're comparing people, things, or days.

grammars.title: Saying "the same"
body: When two things are the same, Khmer has two words you'll hear all the time.

head: Khmer
Say it
Meaning
Example
rows: ខ្ញុំក៏ដូចគ្នាដែរ — same here
តម្លៃស្មើគ្នា — the prices are the same
ដូចបងស្រីខ្ញុំ — like my older sister
as big as, as much as
ធំប៉ុននេះ — this big
មិនដូចគ្នាទេ

after: ⚠️ **ដូចគ្នា is one of the most useful phrases in everyday Khmer.** It works on its own for "me too", "you too", and "we agree". If someone says អរគុណ (thank you), answering ដូចគ្នា means "likewise". One word, three uses.

blocks.text: Cambodians compliment warmly but without going overboard. Gushing praise for something small can sound like gentle mockery. These five phrases are safe in any situation.

head: English
Khmer
Say it
rows: បងពូកែណាស់
បងនិយាយខ្មែរពូកែ
នេះល្អជាងគេ

blocks.title: ⚠️ How to accept a compliment
items: **Don't agree with praise about yourself.** Answering "yes, I really am clever" sounds very rude in Cambodia. The right answer is to play it down.
**អត់ទេ ខ្ញុំចេះបន្តិចទេ** (*'at té, khnyom chéh ban-tech té*) — "oh no, I only know a little". This is the standard reply when someone praises your Khmer, and Cambodians will beam when they hear it.
A simple **អរគុណ** is also fine, especially with younger people or at work.

head: Khmer
Say it
Meaning
Example comparison
rows: ធំជាងគេ — the biggest
ថ្លៃជាង — more expensive
ច្រើនជាងម្សិលមិញ — more than yesterday
តិចជាង — fewer, less
ជិតជាងគេ — the nearest
ចាស់ជាងខ្ញុំ — older than me
ចំណាស់ជាង — older (buildings)
ស្អាតជាងគេ — the most beautiful

blocks.text: ⚠️ Notice the pair **ចាស់** and **ចំណាស់**. ចាស់ is for people and everyday things; ចំណាស់ stresses age as a quality, and it's the one used for buildings, temples, and trees. At A1, ចាស់ will always be understood.

items: ជាង / ខ្ញុំ / ចាស់ / គាត់
ជាងគេ / ស្អាត / នេះ / ព្រឹក
ដែរ / ក៏ / ដូចគ្នា / ខ្ញុំ

answers: បាយ័នតូចជាងអង្គរវត្ត។ — ថ្ងៃនេះក្តៅជាងម្សិលមិញ។ — បន្ទប់នេះថោកជាងបន្ទប់នោះ។ — គាត់ចាស់ជាងខ្ញុំ។
ជាងគេ — ជាង — ដូចគ្នា — ជាងគេ
គាត់ចាស់ជាងខ្ញុំ។ — ព្រឹកនេះស្អាតជាងគេ។ — ខ្ញុំក៏ដូចគ្នាដែរ។ — ថោកជាងបន្តិច។
ធំជាងខ្ញុំគិត។ — ប្រាសាទធំជាងគេក្នុងពិភពលោក។ — ថ្ងៃនេះមនុស្សច្រើនជាង។ — ខ្ញុំក៏ដូចគ្នាដែរ។ — ស្ងាត់ជាងបន្តិច។ — នេះស្អាតជាងគេ។
